svg.title: Step 7 mockup 03: Teams: start one, invite, join, and the crew's fill-up (player, team leader)
svg.text: 03 · Teams: start one, invite, join, and the crew's fill-up (player, team leader)
Use case: a team leader registers a team of five for Demo Arena 5v5 and gathers players by a link or a code; a solo player is put on a team

g.text: Shown on the screen; the crew may rename it
You lead the team: you can invite,
remove and hand the lead over.
A team short at the close goes to
the crew: they fill it from solo
players or move it to the list.
Ask the crew to fill it
The crew placed you with three
Say hi in the team chat
Team chat is Discord's: the bot makes

svg.text: A team is an entity (new): a name, a leader and members; the legacy formed teams by voice channel (U3).
Invites by a link or a short code, valid until the close; no token in a URL ever names a person (U3).
One team per player per session, enforced under a row lock with a race test (E1).
Team size and substitutes come from the session's format (D2).
Short teams are the crew's call at the close, never silently dropped (U6, E7).
Solo registrants can be placed on teams by the crew, by hand or by 'fill from standings' (U6).
